pages.en:
（印：Due 16 / 6 / 32）
Special Branches,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Material Reported on

Gas pistol and liquids for use in same. Handed
in by Supt. Yorke.

Received 31.7.31 Report No. 40029 Sent Out 6.8.31

The pistol is designed for the ejection of
liquid by means of compressed air. It is charged
by removing the air valve at the base and introduc-
ing the liquid into the chamber. The valve is then
replaced and air pumped in. In use, a trigger action
withdraws a needle valve from its seating and establi-
shes communication between the chamber and the nozzle
and the liquid is ejected in the form of a fine spray.

At a demonstration the pistol was charged with
the contents of one vial (about ½ fluid ounce) of
liquid No.3 and a spray of liquid was thrown to a
distance of some 10 to 12 feet. This was with the
ordinary nozzle and not with the extension barrel.

The three liquids were in vials marked Nos. 1, 2
and 3 respectively. Each vial held approximately ½
fluid ounce of liquid and this amount is apparently
the charge for the pistol. The active basis of the
liquids is volatile oil of mustard and the three samples
differ in the amount of this ingredient present. Rough
determinations indicate the following approximate amounts
to be present.

Liquid No.1 ............70 percent
" No.2 ............45 " "
" No.3 ............42 " "

The remainder of the liquid in Nos. 2 and 3 appears to be
largely a fixed oil.

Pure volatile oil of mustard is a liquid with an
intensely pungent odour and acrid taste. It is a very
powerful irritant and in contact with the skin causes
almost immediate painful blistering.

A spray of either of the three liquids fired into
the face would result in immediate painful injury to the
eyes and skin and might possibly result in permanent
injury to the eyes. Injury to the respiratory passages
might also be caused.

(Sgd) F.G.A. Walker,
Analyst. Commissioner of Public Health.

Lee Hangkew J.S.R No 1673/31.
pages.zh:
（印：1932年6月16日到期）
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
特别部门。

报告材料

气体手枪及供其使用的液体。由约克警司（Supt. Yorke）提交。

1931年7月31日收到，报告编号40029，1931年8月6日发出

该手枪设计用于通过压缩空气喷射液体。装填时需卸下底部的空气阀，将液体注入腔室。随后重新装上阀门并泵入空气。使用时，扳机动作会将针阀从阀座中拔出，使腔室与喷嘴连通，液体即以细雾状喷出。

在一次演示中，手枪装填了一小瓶（约½液量盎司）3号液体的内容物，喷出的液雾射程约为10至12英尺。此次测试使用的是普通喷嘴，而非延长枪管。

三种液体分别装在标有1、2和3号的小瓶中。每瓶盛有约½液量盎司的液体，此剂量显然即为该手枪的装填量。这些液体的活性成分为挥发性芥子油，三个样品的区别在于该成分的含量不同。粗略测定显示大致含量如下：

1号液体 ............70%
2号液体 ............45%
3号液体 ............42%

2号和3号液体中的剩余部分似乎主要为固定油。

纯挥发性芥子油是一种具有强烈刺激性气味和辛辣味道的液体。它是一种极强的刺激剂，接触皮肤几乎会立即引起疼痛性水泡。

将这三种液体中的任何一种以喷雾形式射向面部，会导致眼睛和皮肤立即受到疼痛性伤害，并可能造成眼睛永久性损伤。还可能对呼吸道造成伤害。

（签名）F.G.A. 沃克，
分析师。公共卫生专员。

李恒贵（Lee Hangkew），J.S.R 编号 1673/31。
